name: Four Points by Sheraton Nha Trang
short_description: Four Points by Sheraton Nha Trang is a select-service contemporary high-rise in central Nha Trang, a few minutes' walk from Tran Phu Beach, with an outdoor pool, all-day dining and a poolside bar.
ai_summary: Four Points by Sheraton Nha Trang is a select-service, contemporary high-rise hotel that opened in May 2025 in the centre of Nha Trang, a few minutes' walk from Tran Phu Beach and close to the city's night market and seafront promenade. It is the fourth Four Points in Vietnam and holds 225 rooms and suites aimed at the brand's mix of business and leisure travellers rather than resort-goers. Because the property is new, early independent coverage and guest feedback are limited but consistently positive: reviewers highlight bright, spotless, modern rooms, attentive and friendly front-desk and call-centre service, and a genuinely central location with restaurants, cafes and the beach within easy reach. Dining centres on The Mesh all-day restaurant, serving European and Vietnamese dishes, with light bites and cocktails at the poolside Riley's Bar. Facilities include an outdoor pool, a fitness centre and roughly 117 square metres of ballroom plus two smaller meeting rooms for events. Honest watch-outs reflect the format and its newness: this is a city hotel rather than a beachfront resort, so guests wanting sand at the doorstep will need the short walk to Tran Phu Beach; as a Four Points it offers a leaner facility set than a full-service Sheraton; and with only a small pool of reviews so far, long-term consistency of service and dining is not yet proven.

faqs.question: Is Four Points by Sheraton Nha Trang on the beach?
faqs.answer: No, it is a central city high-rise rather than a beachfront resort, but Tran Phu Beach and Nha Trang's seafront promenade are only a few minutes' walk away, along with restaurants, cafes and the night market in the surrounding city centre.

faqs.question: When did the hotel open and how many rooms does it have?
faqs.answer: The hotel opened on May 29, 2025 as the fourth Four Points by Sheraton in Vietnam. It has 225 contemporary guest rooms and suites, along with an outdoor pool, a fitness centre, all-day dining and a poolside bar in a modern high-rise building.

faqs.question: How far is the hotel from Cam Ranh International Airport?
faqs.answer: Cam Ranh International Airport (CXR) sits south of the city, roughly 35 kilometres from the hotel, which is a drive of about 45 minutes depending on traffic. The property is in central Nha Trang rather than out near the airport or the southern resort strip.
